methodology.fixture_integrity: Mach-O embedded section, normal format 12; header payload length and authenticated SHA-256 verified before deserialization. Program is the first field in PackEnvelope.

prepare_probe.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,struct
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'target/validation-fast-path-20261004'
binary_path=root/'target/runtime-startup-experiment-20261004/baseline/empty-packed'
binary=binary_path.read_bytes()
magic,_,_,_,ncmds,_,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<IiiIIIII',binary)
assert magic==0xfeedfacf
cursor=32;sections=[]
for _ in range(ncmds):
 command,size=struct.unpack_from('<II',binary,cursor)
 if command==0x19:
  for index in range(struct.unpack_from('<I',binary,cursor+64)[0]):
   fields=struct.unpack_from('<16s16sQQIIIIIIII',binary,cursor+72+80*index)
   if fields[0].rstrip(b'\0')==b'baaaaaaaaaaaaaml':
    sections.append(binary[fields[4]:fields[4]+fields[3]])
 cursor+=size
assert len(sections)==1
artifact=sections[0]
assert artifact[:8]==b'BAMLART\0'
format_version,header_len=struct.unpack_from('<IQ',artifact,8)
assert format_version==12
header=artifact[20:20+header_len]
payload=artifact[20+header_len:]
fingerprint_len=struct.unpack_from('<I',header)[0]
fingerprint=header[4:4+fingerprint_len].decode()
kind_offset=4+fingerprint_len
payload_len=struct.unpack_from('<Q',header,kind_offset+1)[0]
assert payload_len==len(payload)
assert hashlib.sha256(struct.pack('<I',format_version)+header[:kind_offset+1+8]+payload).digest()==header[-32:]
(out/'payload.borsh').write_bytes(payload)
(out/'fixture.json').write_text(json.dumps({'binary':str(binary_path),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary).hexdigest(),'artifact_sha256':hashlib.sha256(artifact).hexdigest(),'payload_sha256':hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest(),'format':format_version,'build_fingerprint':fingerprint,'bytes':len(payload)},indent=2))
original=(out/'original-validate.rs').read_text()
original=original.replace('    pub fn validate(&self)', 'fn validate_original(program: &Program)')
original=original.replace('self.', 'program.').replace('self\n', 'program\n').replace('crate::','bex_vm_types::')
probe=(root/'target/loading-passes-experiment-20261004/validation_probe.rs').read_text()
probe=probe.replace('use bex_vm_types::{ConstValue, GlobalIndex, Object, ObjectIndex, Program};', 'use bex_vm_types::{ConstValue, DeclPath, GlobalIndex, Object, ObjectIndex, ObjectType, Program};\nuse indexmap::IndexMap;\nuse std::collections::{BTreeSet, HashSet};\nuse borsh::BorshDeserialize;')
probe=probe.replace('let eager = program.validate();','let eager = validate_original(program);')
probe=probe.replace('let deferred = program.validate_lazy_diagnostics();','let deferred = program.validate();')
probe=probe.replace('base.validate().unwrap();','validate_original(&base).unwrap();',1)
probe=probe.replace('base.validate_lazy_diagnostics().unwrap();','base.validate().unwrap();')
probe=probe.replace('    let envelope: baml_exec::PackEnvelope=baml_artifact::decode(baml_artifact::ArtifactKind::PackedProgram,&bytes).unwrap();\n    let base=envelope.program;', '    let base=Program::deserialize(&mut bytes.as_slice()).unwrap();')
probe=probe.replace('"deferred":deferred_allocations','"two_pass":deferred_allocations')
probe='use bex_vm_types::types::{InvalidProgram, LocalName};\n'+probe+'\n'+original+'\n'
(out/'probe.rs').write_text(probe)
print('Extracted and integrity-verified normal-format fixture; frozen original validator is the differential oracle.')

build_probe.py.text:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'target/validation-fast-path-20261004'
artifacts=[json.loads(line) for line in (out/'release-artifacts.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
entry=next(x for x in artifacts if x.get('reason')=='compiler-artifact' and x['target']['name']=='bex_vm_types' and 'lib' in x['target']['kind'])
library=next(Path(p) for p in entry['filenames'] if p.endswith('.rlib'))
if library.parent.name != 'deps':
 digest=hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).digest()
 library=next(p for p in (root/'target/release/deps').glob('libbex_vm_types-*.rlib')
              if p.stat().st_size == library.stat().st_size and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest()==digest)
fps=root/'target/release/.fingerprint'
owner=fps/library.stem.removeprefix('lib')/'lib-bex_vm_types.json'
assert owner.is_file(),owner
selected={'bex_vm_types':library}
for _,name,_,fp in json.loads(owner.read_text())['deps']:
 if name not in ['borsh','serde_json','indexmap']:continue
 path=next(p for p in fps.glob(f'{name}-*/lib-{name}.json')
           if int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(p.with_suffix('').read_text()),'little')==fp)
 selected[name]=root/'target/release/deps'/f'lib{path.parent.name}.rlib'
cmd=['rustc','--edition=2024','-C','opt-level=3','-C','lto=thin','-C','codegen-units=1',str(out/'probe.rs'),'-o',str(out/'probe'),'-L',f'dependency={root}/target/release/deps']
for name,path in selected.items():
 assert path.is_file(),path
 cmd+=['--extern',f'{name}={path}']
(out/'probe-build.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'host_library':str(owner),'libraries':{k:str(v) for k,v in selected.items()}},indent=2))
subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
result=subprocess.run([str(out/'probe'),str(out/'payload.borsh')],capture_output=True)
assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr.decode()
(out/'checks.json').write_bytes(result.stdout)
checks=json.loads(result.stdout)
print(len(checks['checks']),'exact-result/error comparisons passed.',checks['valid_program_allocation_requests'])
